# ADR-005: What to delete, archive and keep

**Status.** Accepted 2026-09-09. Supersedes the disposal half of ADR-002.

**Context.** About 40,000 lines were generated by an unattended orchestration loop on top of an adapter that did not work. The audit froze all of it. Freezing was right; the earlier framing — "move it to an archive branch within a month" — was not, because two of those subsystems are the implementation of hypotheses the first-users experiment is about to test (H3 parallelism, H6 automation). Deleting them on a timer would destroy the answer's payoff before the question is asked.

**Decision.** Three dispositions, decided per subsystem, and the archive decision waits for the experiment.

### KEEP — used by the current product or a stated guarantee

| Subsystem | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Git subsystem (`services/git/*`) | The Changes view is core. |
| Secret vault, environment secrets | Credentials reach agent sessions through it; encrypted at rest. |
| Migration engine, channels, `db:*` CLI | Every database change depends on it. |
| Sovereign mode | A stated, verifiable guarantee. |
| Process tree manager, terminal service, throttler | Core loop. |
| Project Memory + MCP memory server | H4. Present, hidden from primary navigation, the leading moat candidate. |
| MCP supervisor and tool gateway | Dormant on the Claude Code path (it speaks MCP natively) but the approval gate for tool calls is real, and `--mcp-config` is the obvious next use. Low carrying cost. |
| Cloud relay **server** (`apps/relay`) | A separate deployable, unused at launch, costs nothing in the Core. |

### FROZEN, decision deferred to the experiment

Not deleted, not extended, not marketed, not in primary navigation. Each is tied to a hypothesis; the day-14 report decides.

| Subsystem | Tied to | Revived if |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Delegation (parent/child threads, sandboxes) | H3, H6 | Users run several agents on one project and want isolation. |
| Pipelines, worktree fleet, verification gates | H6 | Users ask to repeat or chain work rather than retype it. |
| Team agents, turn lock | Team dimension | More than one person wants the same instance — also the likeliest paid dimension. |
| Desktop daemon, tray, OS notifications | H3 | Users want to be told when an agent finishes. |
| Relay client, push, mDNS | Remote dimension | Users want their workstation from outside the LAN. |
| Accounts, sessions, devices, API keys, billing | Monetisation | Something is actually being sold. |

### DELETE — dead with no future

| Item | Status |
| --- | --- |
| Aider adapter stub | Removed from the UI; the stub file goes with the next cleanup. |
| Fabricated marketing pages, download page, account portal | Deleted 2026-09-08. |
| Root debug scripts, committed logs and databases, pipeline runtime state | Deleted 2026-09-08 (`docs/development/housekeeping.md`). |
| Enterprise fleet policy and SIEM exporter | The only subsystem with no plausible route back: GitHub, Microsoft and Anthropic ship this natively for the segment Asterim does not serve. Archive to a branch and remove from `main` once migration 006's tables are confirmed unused. |

**Consequences.** `main` carries frozen code that new contributors must be told to ignore, which `CLAUDE.md` does. In exchange, a positive answer on H3 or H6 turns weeks of existing work into the roadmap instead of a rewrite. Re-evaluate at the end of Phase 2, not on a calendar.
